verdict.rationale: BugSnag provides documented controls for retroactive data redaction/removal for compliance (GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA) and event usage controls to limit what's saved/counted, plus an on-premise self-hosted option for full data control. However, there's no explicit documentation of user-initiated data deletion workflows, retention period configuration, or deletion SLAs/timelines. Missing for 10: explicit data retention period settings, self-service bulk deletion tooling, and independent verification of deletion guarantees.
